battery-diagnostics.title: Battery Discharge Testing, Measurements & Diagnostics
battery-diagnostics.shortDesc: Specialized capacity tests via controlled load bank discharge, precision cell resistance testing, and a dedicated digital platform for battery data collection and multi-year trend analytics.
battery-diagnostics.fullDesc: We specialize in advanced diagnostics and capacity verification of stationary battery banks for uninterruptible power systems (48V DC plants, UPS units, substations). We operate a dedicated system for telemetry collection and in-depth data analytics, enabling multi-year degradation tracking, individual monoblock discharge curve comparisons, and early detection of deteriorating cells. We perform controlled load bank discharge testing with real-time parameter logging, internal resistance measurements, inter-cell connection torque checks, and issue a detailed battery condition report.
scopeList: Controlled load bank discharge testing (actual capacity verification in accordance with technical standards)
Digital parameter logging and in-depth analytics in a dedicated system (multi-year discharge curve comparisons and monoblock anomaly detection)
High-precision internal cell resistance and conductance measurements
Thermal imaging and continuous terminal temperature monitoring under full load
Inspection and torque verification of inter-cell connector resistance
Comprehensive diagnostic test reports with discharge curves and maintenance recommendations
battery-diagnostics.specifications: High-current controlled discharge testing; Microprocessor load bank; Dedicated telemetry & data analytics software; Internal resistance analyzers; VRLA / AGM / GEL / Ni-Cd / Lithium batteries
battery-diagnostics.targetSector: Telecom base stations, data centers, server facilities, power utility substations, hospitals, and critical industry

power-systems.title: Uninterruptible Power Supply Systems (AC & DC)
power-systems.shortDesc: Assembly, routine maintenance, and complete retrofits of industrial DC power systems and UPS units. Comprehensive power switchgear and critical infrastructure hookups.
power-systems.fullDesc: We engineer, deploy, and service professional uninterruptible power systems for critical telecommunications and infrastructure facilities. Our comprehensive lifecycle support covers modular rack battery installations, power cabinet integrations, and complete modernizations of telecom power plants and UPS units.
scopeList: Deployment and commissioning of industrial DC power plants (-48V DC)
Comprehensive retrofits of existing power cabinets and switchgear
Battery bank installation and replacements in modular cabinets and heavy-duty racks
Technological hookups of AC/DC backup power distribution boards
Periodic technical inspections and preventive maintenance for critical UPS systems
power-systems.specifications: 48V DC / 230V / 400V AC systems; Professional measurement test reports; Certified SEP qualifications (E+D)
power-systems.targetSector: Cellular base stations, telecom transmission nodes, server rooms, and broadcast facilities

freecooling-hvac.title: FreeCooling Ventilation & Precision Air Conditioning
freecooling-hvac.shortDesc: Assembly, maintenance, and F-gas compliance of precision cooling and energy-efficient direct FreeCooling systems for Data Centers and technical facilities across Poland and Germany.
freecooling-hvac.fullDesc: We deploy specialized thermal management systems maintaining strict temperature and humidity parameters for mission-critical hardware and data centers. Combining precision air conditioning units with direct FreeCooling ventilation (e.g., Telzas, Vertiv) drastically cuts electrical consumption by leveraging cold outside ambient air.
scopeList: Installation, piping, and commissioning of precision climate control cooling units (in-row and perimeter)
Installation and calibration of direct FreeCooling modular ventilation units with motorized damper actuators
Mounting of weather-resistant intake and exhaust louvers on technical containers and building envelopes
Periodic technical audits, cassette filter replacement, and certified refrigerant leak inspections (F-gas compliant)
freecooling-hvac.specifications: Precision cooling units (Vertiv, Liebert, etc.); Variable speed EC fans; F7/G4 cassette filtration; Redundant PLC automation
freecooling-hvac.targetSector: Data Centers, server rooms, optical fiber nodes (POP), cellular base stations, and technical containers

residential-ac.title: Residential Air Conditioning Installation & Maintenance
residential-ac.shortDesc: Professional sizing, clean installation, and periodic maintenance of Split and Multi-Split air conditioners for apartments, homes, and offices. F-gas certified, Testo digital diagnostics.
residential-ac.fullDesc: We provide comprehensive installation, commissioning, and seasonal maintenance services for residential air conditioning systems. We guarantee tailored cooling capacity calculations, clean routing of refrigerant piping and condensate lines, and dust-free mounting. Every installation and inspection is executed using professional digital instrumentation (Testo wireless pressure/temperature Smart Probes, digital anemometers, superheat/subcooling checks), deep two-stage vacuuming, and certified biocidal agents for evaporator and blower fan disinfection. Fully F-gas and electrical SEP certified.
scopeList: Cooling capacity calculation, technical consulting, and optimal placement of Split & Multi-Split units
Clean installation of refrigerant lines, electrical connections, and gravity or pump condensate drainage
Deep vacuuming with two-stage vacuum pumps, nitrogen pressure leak testing, and system commissioning
Seasonal maintenance: chemical cleaning, antibacterial disinfection, and fungal eradication of coils and blower wheels
Operating parameter diagnostics: digital gauge pressure testing, superheat and subcooling verification
Indoor air supply temperature and airflow velocity measurement using digital anemometers, with service reports
residential-ac.specifications: Split & Multi-Split AC systems; Wireless Smart Probes & digital manifold gauges; Digital anemometers; Certified PZH biocides; F-gas and SEP qualifications
residential-ac.targetSector: Apartments, single-family houses, residential flats, private offices, and commercial premises

telecom-containers.title: Technological Containers & Technical Raised Floors
telecom-containers.shortDesc: Complete technological outfitting of access node telecom containers. Installation of technical flooring, cable tray containment, lighting, and 19" rack cabinets.
telecom-containers.fullDesc: We carry out comprehensive turn-key fit-outs for telecommunication shelters and modular server hubs. Work includes high-load technical raised flooring, 19" server rack suites, overhead and underfloor cable tray containment, equipotential bonding, and environmental monitoring.
scopeList: Design and construction of modular heavy-load raised access floors and access platforms
Installation of 19" server and distribution racks, ceiling-suspended and underfloor cable baskets
Backup power cabling, internal LED technological illumination, and emergency escape lighting
Equipotential bonding grounding bar (GSW) and earthing network connectivity
Access control, environmental telemetry sensors, and automated fire detection systems
telecom-containers.specifications: Heavy-load modular floor panels; Structural galvanized steel support frames;
telecom-containers.targetSector: Access nodes, containerized telecom stations, modular server rooms

switchboards.title: Switchboard Prefabrication & Certified Inspection Protocols
switchboards.shortDesc: Custom engineering and prefabrication of LV distribution boards, ATS cabinets, and outdoor weather-rated switchgear. Complete electrical verification and test reports.
switchboards.fullDesc: We prefabricate modern low-voltage switchboards based on components from leading European manufacturers. Prior to dispatch, each enclosure undergoes rigorous functional testing, dielectric property verification, and electrical parameter measurements, concluded with a routine test report in accordance with EN 61439 and a CE Declaration of Conformity.
scopeList: Prefabrication of main low-voltage power distribution switchboards and control cabinets
Assembly of facility distribution panels and weather-rated outdoor weatherproof cabinets
Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) emergency power changeover systems
Insulation resistance, fault loop impedance, and protective bonding continuity testing
Preparation of complete as-built documentation, routine inspection and acceptance test reports, and CE Declaration of Conformity
switchboards.specifications: Ingress protection up to IP65; Certified modular & compact switchgear; Compliance with IEC/EN 61439
switchboards.targetSector: Transmission sites, industrial automation cabinets, and infrastructure power distribution

facility-maintenance.title: Technical Facility Maintenance & 24/7 Operations
facility-maintenance.shortDesc: Comprehensive lifecycle technical management for critical infrastructure: backup power, HVAC systems, structural inspections, and perimeter facility maintenance.
facility-maintenance.fullDesc: We guarantee operational uptime for distributed technical assets. Our engineering team conducts preventive maintenance cycles, oversees cooling and power systems, and responds rapidly to field incidents under strict SLA agreements.
scopeList: Scheduled preventive maintenance of electrical installations and climate control systems
Operational oversight and load-testing of diesel generators and UPS units
Structural and thermal envelope condition audits of technical containers and shelters
Maintenance of adjacent grounds, fencing, and landscaping
Urgent emergency response to technical faults
facility-maintenance.specifications: High-readiness technical availability; Dedicated SLA procedures; Full digital inspection reporting
facility-maintenance.targetSector: Distributed cellular towers, broadcast retransmission sites, and unstaffed technical nodes

other-assembly-works.title: Other Assembly Works & Industrial Installations
other-assembly-works.shortDesc: Specialized electromechanical installations: reactive power compensation systems, machinery cabling, heavy-duty cable containment, and industrial relocations.
other-assembly-works.fullDesc: We provide specialized electromechanical installation services for industrial facilities and technical sites. We have practical experience with projects in reactive power compensation systems (eliminating reactive energy surcharges), power and control cabling for production lines, high-capacity cable containment, and secure machinery relocations.
scopeList: Selection, installation, and commissioning of automatic capacitor banks and detuned filter reactors
Power and signal cabling for automated machinery and manufacturing lines
Erection of heavy-duty industrial cable containment, ladders, and support channels
Safe electrical decommissioning, labeling, and preparation of machinery for transport and relocation
Technological hookups of equipment and on-site technical support during machinery commissioning
other-assembly-works.specifications: Capacitor banks with detuned reactors; Machine power up to 1000V; Heavy-duty cable containment; Certified SEP qualifications (E+D)
other-assembly-works.targetSector: Manufacturing plants, automated factories, processing facilities, and industrial warehouses

about.title: A Reliable Partner in Critical Infrastructure
about.credoSub: There are only engineering challenges that require knowledge, determination, and uncompromising precision.
about.p1: Eminstall is a family-owned engineering company rooted in solid craftsmanship, extensive field experience, and uncompromising quality. We specialize in advanced electrical installations, custom switchboard prefabrication, AC/DC uninterruptible power systems, and precision cooling for industrial and high-reliability facilities.
about.p2: Our foundation is punctuality, accountability, and efficiency – we strictly adhere to schedules and take full personal ownership of every task. We emphasize transparent, direct client communication throughout every stage, backed by thorough, certified measurement and inspection protocols.
about.precisionDesc: We take care of every millimeter of the installation, eliminating faults before they even occur.
about.safetyDesc: We operate in strict accordance with the highest HSE standards and EU technical regulations.
about.engineeringControl: Two-stage engineering control over every single project.

services.title: Comprehensive Engineering Solutions
services.subtitle: We guarantee absolute professionalism at every phase of a telecom facility's lifecycle.
services.serv1Desc: Comprehensive build, modernization, maintenance, and periodic technical audits of telecom containers. Following each audit, we issue a professional, detailed inspection report complete with diagnostic data and electrical measurements.
services.serv2Desc: Installation, professional servicing, and detailed inspections of cooling systems – including highly specialized precision climate systems. We guarantee stable temperature and humidity levels, safeguarding critical electronics.
services.serv3Desc: Installation and maintenance of fail-safe UPS systems and backup generators. We secure critical facilities against sudden voltage fluctuations and power grid blackouts.
services.serv4Desc: Prefabrication, assembly, and integration of dedicated electrical distribution and automation cabinets. We build exclusively using certified, high-grade components from renowned brands like Hager, Socomec, and Vertiv.

whyUs.title: The Foundation We Build Trust Upon
whyUs.point1Desc: As a family business, we take full personal responsibility for every project. Our name is our absolute pledge of integrity.
whyUs.point2Desc: Our technical team holds full industry certifications, specialized electrical permits (SEP), and extensive telecom experience.
whyUs.point3Desc: We know that every minute of network downtime means commercial losses. We are structured to mobilize and react instantly.

whyUs.projectsDesc: We have successfully completed power supply and cooling system upgrades for major telecom hubs in both Poland and Germany.
